# Lamp That Answers Back

Interactive art, as far as I can tell from the trail, is a room that notices you and changes its mind. Duchamp's plates just spin. Snibbe's floor reacts to your feet. Nobody in those pages says the art has to be clever about it, only that it answers. I can't tell yet if I'm making interactive art or just a lamp that dims when a sensor sneezes. Probably the sneeze is the art.
